WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) rn FROM fact_sales_line f
), sl AS (SELECT * FROM s WHERE rn=1),
gross AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(sl.net_amount) sales, sum(CASE WHEN NOT sl.staff_purchase_flag THEN sl.net_amount ELSE 0 END) sales_exstaff
  FROM sl JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=sl.store_key
  WHERE sl.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) refunds, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dn
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
rp AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT g.store_id, d.store_name, d.sqm, g.sales, g.sales_exstaff, r.refunds, g.sales-coalesce(r.refunds,0) net, r.n, r.dn, rp.rpt_net, rp.rpt_before
FROM gross g JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name, sqm FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) d USING (store_id)
LEFT JOIN ret r USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN rp USING (store_id) ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 16

SELECT coalesce(st.store_id,-1) store_id, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN st.valid_from AND st.valid_to THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) outside_version, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, round(sum(f.net_amount)) tot
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tot DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) rn FROM fact_sales_line f),
a AS (SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, sum(s.net_amount) g FROM s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=s.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=s.sale_date WHERE s.rn=1 AND st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
b AS (SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, sum(r.refund_net) rf FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
n AS (SELECT a.store_id, a.fiscal_year, a.g-coalesce(b.rf,0) net FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (store_id, fiscal_year)),
rk AS (SELECT *, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year ORDER BY net DESC) r FROM n)
SELECT store_id, max(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN r END) r2425, max(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r END) r2526, max(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN r END) r2627
FROM rk GROUP BY 1 HAVING min(r)<=12 ORDER BY r2526

WITH sales_dedup AS (
  SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales_line f
),
sales AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_sales
  FROM sales_dedup f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE f.rn = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND st.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND st.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1
),
names AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, sqm FROM dim_store WHERE is_current)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.gross_sales - coalesce(r.refund_net, 0) DESC) AS rank,
       s.store_id, n.store_name,
       round(s.gross_sales - coalesce(r.refund_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (store_id) JOIN names n USING (store_id)
ORDER BY rank LIMIT 10
